comments.value: this would help a lot for people into horror content and the content creator is well known for making them. instead of having to find their profile and see if they created any recently.

Wait this would actually be really cool. Creators could have followers and be able to check a feed which shows when public avis / worlds of theirs has received an update, and the SDK could be updated to add a 'update note' section. On top of that, users can optionally subscribe to the feed to receive notifications for all the creators updates (avi + world) or specifically for a world.

details:
Allow users to follow creators so they see when they have released a new world or avatars. 

It may work best with just worlds for now. 

So for example if I upload a world and someone likes that world and wishes to see more from me they can follow me and when I upload a new map it will show up under a playlist. Similar to favourites etc.. Lets say you allow users to follow up to 3 creators so they get to see their worlds under 3 seperate playlists.

Or you could have 1 playlist which is just called Following and only shows worlds from creators you follow.
